summary: The Goshen Township Zoning Commission held a continuation hearing on Zoning Case ZC 2025-008, the final development plan for the Enclave Creek PDR, a 34-unit attached residential condominium development on 16.16 acres. The applicant presented an updated landscaping plan replacing previously proposed fencing with evergreen trees along the northern and southern boundaries. The commission approved the final development plan with stipulations regarding construction hours, weekly cleanup of mud and debris, and provision of a construction dumpster. The commission also briefly discussed an upcoming zone change request for a storage facility on State Route 28.

notes: This was a continuation from the August 3, 2026 meeting where significant public comment had been received. The commission noted that land clearing had occurred prior to permits being issued, which contributed to their decision to continue the case rather than approve at the prior meeting. Mr. Frisbee was present for roll call but did not vote on the final development plan motion. The applicant clarified that individual low-pressure sewer systems would be used rather than a lift station.
